title: A closed zero-dimensional subset of a Noetherian T0 space is finite with closed points
statement: Let $X$ be a topological space which is Noetherian (every nonempty set of closed subsets of $X$ has a minimal element for inclusion) and $T_0$ (for any two distinct points $x\ne y$ of $X$ there is an open subset of $X$ containing exactly one of them), and let $Z\subseteq X$ be a closed subset. If the Krull dimension of $Z$ with the subspace topology satisfies $\dim Z\le 0$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], then $Z$ is finite and $\{z\}$ is closed in $X$ for every $z\in Z$.
